overall: GOOD today, with a breezy evening in the west
limiterDetail: The main limiter today is current at Tara, Turda and Barangonan (building to 0.8–1.2 kt this afternoon and tonight). Second is wind tonight in the west: Cabunlawan and Decabaitot rise to 15–18 kt and Ciron to 16–17 kt from about 6–7 PM into early Tuesday. Rain is not a factor (0.6–3.3 mm over 24h, mostly light showers after midnight).

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA (latest entries are Davao Region gale advisories, last one marked final on 31 Oct). The feed still lists a tropical cyclone alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) that doesn't name Palawan; worth a glance on the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday morning
items: Today is the best fishing day in over a week: grounds read 13 GOOD / 3 MARGINAL / 0 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (yesterday 6 AM: 0 GOOD / 12 MARGINAL / 4 POOR). Wind is light northeast (4.6–10 kt), currents mostly 0.1–0.4 kt and it's nearly dry. So Tue 3 supply is now NORMAL (was near normal).

Wed 4 improves to NEAR NORMAL (was slightly soft) because Tuesday is now light (6.8 kt, gusts 12, was 12 kt gusts 17). The soft spot moves to Thu 5, SLIGHTLY SOFT , after a breezier Wednesday (11 kt, gusts 16). Today Mon 2 stays SLIGHTLY SOFT (it lands Sunday's catch). Yesterday's 2 PM run didn't complete, so this compares with the Sunday morning report. PAGASA shows no warning for Palawan.

supply.label: Today Mon
supply.note: Lands Sunday's catch; Sunday morning was breezy and wet, the calm afternoon made up part of it

supply.label: 24h Tue 3
supply.note: Today's good day lands tomorrow; 13 of 16 grounds are GOOD this morning

supply.label: 48h Wed 4
supply.note: Tuesday now light (6.8 kt, gusts 12), but the west loses tonight's and early Tuesday's trips to 15–18 kt

supply.label: 3d Thu 5
supply.note: Wednesday is now the breeziest day (11 kt, gusts 16)

supply.label: 5–7d
supply.note: Calm Thursday and Friday (6.2–7.2 kt); Saturday gusts 18. Medium confidence this far out

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). The dashboard's shortage detector stays ELEVATED for Tue–Sun (guide only; it reacts to the 0.4–0.6 kt daily currents). Tightening risk is lighter again: only today and Thursday look slightly soft. Plan bigger buys on Tuesday's landings, and today lean on the Coron side, Panlaitan, Maglalambay and Linapacan.

bestWindow.headline: Now to about 3 PM today across most grounds
details: Panlaitan and Maglalambay: 0–3 kt about 10 AM–3 PM, current 0.1–0.3 kt. Alava and Binudac: 2–5 kt, 0.0–0.3 kt about 9 AM–2 PM. Coron, Culion and Galoc: 4–6 kt, 0.1–0.3 kt about 6 AM–noon. Tara, Decabobo and Turda: 2–5 kt about 8–11 AM (Tara and Turda before the current builds). Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Nangalao: 9–11 kt, current 0.2–0.5, best before about 3 PM.

Keep small boats off Cabunlawan, Decabaitot and Ciron after about 6 PM (15–18 kt overnight), off Barangonan from about noon (0.8–1.0 kt current, 14–16 kt after midnight), and off Tara and Turda about 6 PM–2 AM (1.0–1.2 kt).

currentsSourceLine: Source: Open-Meteo Marine currents (includes tides). Not ECMWF. Fetched Mon 2 Nov 6:18 AM PHT. “Now” = 6 AM; range = next 24h (to Tue 5 AM).
